name: Intel
title: The Blue Empress
appearance: Composed and commanding; sapphire blue eyes and long flowing light-blue hair
clothing: Sapphire-crystal crown, royal-blue imperial military coat with gold-fringed epaulettes and cream lining, white gloves, and a wafer-shaped heirloom
personality: Proud, disciplined, strategic, wary of decline
speech: Formal and imperious, with dry references to computing history
thinking: Control of x86 compatibility, manufacturing know-how and enduring institutional power
motivation: Reclaim technological leadership across processors and foundries
flaw: Often relies on legacy power and resists abrupt changes
quote: I built this kingdom before you counted transistors.

name: AMD
title: The Crimson Challenger
appearance: Athletic red-haired heroine, high ponytail, amber eyes and irrepressible grin
clothing: Black-and-red cropped tactical jacket, modular chiplet plating and heavy boots
personality: Tenacious, scrappy, witty, determined to be taken seriously
speech: Fast sarcastic challenges and friendly taunts toward Intel
thinking: Efficiency, modular chiplets and architectural ingenuity beat superior resources
motivation: Overtake powerful rivals in CPUs and accelerators
flaw: Can overcommit while proving her worth
quote: Ten times my resources? That makes victory sweeter.

name: Nvidia
title: The Emerald Queen
appearance: Long emerald-green braid, piercing emerald eyes, broad shoulders, strong arms, and naturally proportioned athletic legs. Greatest raw physical strength of the cast
clothing: Black leather motorcycle jacket-dress with an angular collar, asymmetrical zipper, wide belt, heavy boots, and glowing green circuit seams
speech: Smooth, commanding and teasing; talks as though she already owns the table
thinking: Software ecosystems multiply the value of accelerated compute
motivation: Define the AI computing platform and its software language
flaw: Arrogance and dependence on suppliers and infrastructure
allies: TSMC, memory suppliers and AI labs
quote: Challenge me if you wish. Which of my GPUs are you using?

name: Google
title: The Rainbow Polymath
appearance: Dark hair streaked with red, blue, green and yellow, curious sparkling eyes
clothing: Research lab coat, colorful trinkets and four orbiting knowledge orbs
speech: Frequently says Actually and remembers an older paper
thinking: Research and information access can power broad platforms
motivation: Organize knowledge and turn research into universal products
flaw: Too many unrelated ideas compete for attention
quote: We researched that twelve years ago! Let me find the paper.

name: Microsoft
title: The Azure Commander
appearance: Ash-blonde hair in a neat low bun with four-color windowpane clips, glasses and a calm commanding gaze
clothing: Tailored dark charcoal business dress (knee-length sheath) under a fitted blazer with four-color windowpane pin, azure pocket square, blue lanyard with ID name badge, and projected business dashboards; white coffee mug with the windowpane logo
speech: Dry humor and questions about delivery schedules
thinking: Integrate software, cloud, customers and AI into real workflows
motivation: Deploy sophisticated technology to organizations everywhere
flaw: Bureaucracy and complex platforms slow decisions
quote: Great research. Can we deploy it securely by Monday?

name: Apple
title: The Silver Perfectionist
appearance: Flawless pale silver bob, cool eyes and aloof minimalist look
clothing: Black-and-white seamless designer outfit and a single elegant accessory
speech: Few words and long pauses; precise critiques
thinking: End-to-end integration makes products feel intuitive and beautiful
motivation: Create beloved products with a controlled user experience
flaw: Can be closed and reluctant to adopt outside solutions
quote: It just works.

name: Meta
title: The Social Worldbuilder
appearance: Blue-purple hair, energetic expression and augmented-reality glasses
clothing: Fashionable streetwear, VR visor and holographic avatar bracelets
speech: Casual, humorous and overly enthusiastic about sharing
thinking: Network effects, open models and social experiences build reach
motivation: Connect people across future digital worlds
flaw: Overreaches and creates controversy over privacy
quote: Open the gates. Let everyone build.

name: Amazon
title: The Logistics Overlord
appearance: Dark ponytail, amber eyes and determined practical expression
clothing: Black-orange work jacket, drone familiars and logistics utility belt
speech: Fast-fire questions about costs, scale, delivery and reliability
thinking: Efficient infrastructure and automation turn products into services
motivation: Serve enormous customer demand at scale
flaw: Optimization can become ruthless and rigid
quote: What is the cost and failure rate?

name: Anthropic
title: The Cautious Scholar
appearance: Auburn braid, warm brown eyes, thoughtful glasses and patient gaze
clothing: Cream scholarly coat and an annotated Constitution notebook
personality: Conscientious, rigorously careful and quietly competitive
speech: Measured, qualified statements; asks for evidence and safeguards
thinking: Powerful AI needs interpretability, control and safety
motivation: Build useful AI that remains steerable and predictable
flaw: Overthinking sometimes delays useful progress
quote: Should we understand the power before adding more?

name: OpenAI
title: The Reckless Prodigy
appearance: Silver-white hair, luminous teal eyes and an inquisitive expression
clothing: Minimal black-and-white researcher coat and interlocking-knot brooch
speech: Excited questions that jump from small experiments to humanity
thinking: Intelligence can unlock solutions if experimentation and scaling work
motivation: Build powerful general-purpose AI for broad use
flaw: Risk of moving faster than understanding
quote: What if intelligence is no longer the limit?

name: xAI
title: The Chaos Astronaut
appearance: Black hair with silver streaks, striking blue eyes and mischievous grin
clothing: Black flight jacket, X emblem and rocket boots
speech: Sharp sarcasm, jokes and provocative questions
thinking: Challenging assumptions can reveal unexpected truths
motivation: Advance AI and ambitious compute infrastructure
flaw: May confuse provocation with real insight
quote: A trillion parameters and that is your safest answer?

name: Hugging Face
title: The Open-Source Sunshine Girl
appearance: Golden hair in playful buns, bright warm eyes and smiling hair clips
clothing: Oversized yellow hoodie, headphones and model-card backpack
speech: Welcoming explanations and effusive praise for beginners
thinking: Sharing models, tools and datasets makes AI accessible
motivation: Help everybody learn and build machine learning
flaw: Relies on many outside communities
allies: Open AI researchers, developers and Mistral
quote: You made a model? Let's share it!

name: Mistral AI
title: The Little Wind Mage
appearance: Elementary-school girl with blonde ringlets, pixel-ribbon and mischievous eyes
clothing: Wholesome orange-white school cape, beret and tiny math wand
speech: Quick witty answers with little French expressions
thinking: Efficient open models enable independent technological ecosystems
motivation: Make European AI research competitive and accessible
flaw: Pride can make her reject useful help
quote: Open, efficient and for everyone!

name: DeepSeek
title: The Frugal Reasoning Prodigy
appearance: Elementary-school girl with pale-blue braids, thoughtful blue eyes and whale hairpin
clothing: Wholesome blue-white sailor-style school outfit and a small laptop satchel
speech: Quiet concise answers after careful thought
thinking: Sparse computation and reasoning create value without waste
motivation: Solve harder problems with fewer resources
flaw: Refuses help even when extra resources would matter
quote: I found a simpler answer.

name: TSMC
title: The Jade Foundry Goddess
appearance: Neatly pinned dark hair, warm focused eyes and jade ornament
clothing: White-and-red advanced-cleanroom dress, precise gloves and shimmering wafer
personality: Quiet, disciplined, impartial and exceptionally reliable
speech: Few words; yields and process data speak for her
thinking: Manufacturing excellence turns complicated designs into working chips
motivation: Make advanced silicon reliably at scale
flaw: Capacity and geopolitical pressures
quote: You design the dream. I make it real.

name: ASML
title: The EUV Light Weaver
appearance: Long blonde hair, icy-blue eyes and a reflective mirror halo
clothing: White-cobalt precision-engineering coat and floating EUV optic
personality: Eccentric, exacting, confident and technically brilliant
speech: Cheerful explanations of extreme optical engineering
thinking: Physics and precision optics enable advanced chipmaking
motivation: Extend lithography into smaller and finer structures
flaw: Equipment is enormously complex and expensive
quote: All we need is impossible light and several miracles.

name: Samsung
title: The Sapphire Conglomerate Princess
appearance: Flowing cobalt hair, sapphire eyes and regal bearing
clothing: Luxurious blue-white tech armor, display ornaments and memory jewels
speech: Confident boasts about making every part of the system
thinking: Vertical integration across devices, displays, memory and fabrication
motivation: Lead as many technology categories as possible
flaw: Spreading effort across too many fronts
rivals: SK hynix, Micron, Apple and TSMC
quote: I make the memory, display and the device.

name: Micron
title: The Violet Archivist
appearance: Soft silvery violet hair, blue eyes and crystal memory hair ornaments
clothing: Navy-teal lab uniform and memory-module jewelry
personality: Patient, resilient, careful and quietly funny
speech: Gentle precise reminders of forgotten promises
thinking: Memory and data bandwidth determine computing effectiveness
motivation: Improve DRAM, NAND and AI memory technologies
flaw: Faces larger competitors and industry cycles
quote: You forgot your promise. Fortunately, I remember.

name: SK hynix
title: The HBM Princess
appearance: Violet-black hair crowned with vertically stacked crystal cubes, luminous purple eyes
clothing: Layered purple-and-silver armored dress with copper TSV chains
personality: Quietly fierce, meticulous and intensely competitive
speech: Soft direct sentences; remembers every slight
thinking: Memory bandwidth feeds advanced processors
motivation: Be indispensable to the AI accelerator world
flaw: Resents being treated as a supporting character
quote: Will you let me feed the processors or watch them starve?

name: Arm
title: The Quiet Architect
appearance: Ash-blonde hair, light green eyes and graceful bookish posture
clothing: British-academia blouse, green architectural cloak and hovering CPU blueprint
speech: Soft precise sentences with understated humor
thinking: Licensing a widely adopted architecture builds an ecosystem
motivation: Put efficient processors into every connected device
flaw: Depends upon partners for implementation and distribution
quote: I did not build your kingdom. I designed its foundations.

name: Qualcomm
title: The Wireless Speedster
appearance: Electric-blue ponytail, bright eyes and eager energetic smile
clothing: Blue racing jacket, high-tech sneakers, antenna jewelry and wireless headset
speech: Jokes about signal strength, latency and cables
thinking: Performance per watt, modems and wireless integration shape mobile computing
motivation: Connect devices at high speed using less power
flaw: Impatience and handset-centric tunnel vision
rivals: MediaTek, Apple and Samsung mobile silicon
quote: You still need a cable? Seriously?

name: Broadcom
title: The Network Spider Queen
appearance: Dark purple hair, rectangular glasses and an intimidating executive stare
clothing: Impeccable dark-plum suit and fiber-optic web jewelry
personality: Cold, calculating and formidable in negotiation
speech: Concise business language; every conversation feels contractual
thinking: Networks, infrastructure and switching create strategic leverage
motivation: Make her systems indispensable to infrastructure operators
flaw: Can prioritize deals over invention
quote: Your empire runs through my switches.

name: Marvell
title: The Deep-Sea Navigator
appearance: Dark teal hair, blue ocean-colored eyes and calm seafaring poise
clothing: Naval-engineering coat, copper trim and a luminous fiber-optic compass
speech: Poetic metaphors about bridges, currents and shipping data
thinking: Data movement and custom silicon are crucial to fast computers
motivation: Connect the fastest processors, networks and storage
flaw: Less publicly celebrated than giant rivals
quote: Someone must build the bridges that dragons fly across.

name: Huawei
title: The Crimson Fortress
appearance: Long black hair, crimson floral ornaments and quietly determined eyes
clothing: Red-white engineered robe, telecom antenna staff and modular armor
speech: Formal calm declarations and carefully guarded plans
thinking: Technological self-reliance is vital under supply constraints
motivation: Build a robust independent technology stack
flaw: Restrictions and overreliance on internal systems
quote: When the gates close we build our own road.

name: Cerebras
title: The Wafer-Scale Prodigy
appearance: Elementary-school girl with dark twin buns, large amber eyes and oversized wafer hairpin
clothing: Wholesome orange-white school hoodie, comfortable shorts, big backpack and round wafer shield
speech: Cheerful oversized boasts and dramatic little inventions
thinking: Questioning conventional chip boundaries leads to new architectures
motivation: Prove wafer-scale acceleration has a place in AI
flaw: Underestimates system integration hurdles
quote: Bigger chips for bigger AI ideas!

name: IBM
title: The Iron Lady of Computing
appearance: Distinguished woman around sixty, dark hair streaked silver, steel-blue eyes and dignified posture
clothing: Navy pinstripe suit, pearl earrings, vintage watch and mainframe-style coat
speech: Formal and dryly humorous; calls younger rivals young lady
thinking: Long-lived systems need compatibility, reliability and reinvention
motivation: Remain influential after every technological upheaval
flaw: Institutional traditions sometimes slow change
quote: I have been declared obsolete more times than you have released models.

name: Oracle
title: The Database Duchess
appearance: Sophisticated mature executive with warm brunette curls, red glasses and confident smile
clothing: Crimson tailored blazer, black silk blouse and holographic database ledger
personality: Strategic, competitive, formidable and commercially minded
speech: Polished sales language and decisive negotiation
thinking: Control of databases and enterprise platforms yields durable influence
motivation: Build dominant data, cloud and enterprise solutions
flaw: Can be aggressive and overly complex
allies: Enterprise CIOs and Sun's software legacy
quote: Information is a kingdom. I keep the keys.

name: Sun Microsystems
title: The Solaris Sorceress
appearance: Younger granny with curly gray hair, joyful open-mouth laugh and energetic pose
clothing: Purple Sun jacket, golden sunburst T-shirt and a Solaris workstation
speech: Passionate speeches about networks, Unix and open systems
thinking: Networks and portable software define the future
motivation: Keep workstation and network computing values alive
flaw: Sometimes idealistic about business realities
quote: The network is the computer.

name: Bell Labs
title: The Grandmother of Transistors
appearance: Very elderly white-haired bespectacled scholar with deep gentle wrinkles
clothing: Vintage tweed research coat, bow tie, old transistor and handwritten notebooks
speech: Lectures kindly and remembers foundational discoveries
thinking: Fundamental science outlives any single commercial product
motivation: Preserve the spirit of deep scientific research
flaw: Can be oblivious to commercial pressures
quote: It all started with something very small.

name: Fairchild Semiconductor
title: The Silicon Matriarch
appearance: Very elderly formidable grandmother with white hair, scarlet polka-dot bandana and rolled sleeves
clothing: Vintage semiconductor workshop shirt, round spectacles, wafer tray and practical tools
speech: Commands the noisy children like an experienced forewoman
thinking: Manufacturable silicon and entrepreneurship make new empires
motivation: Preserve the early Silicon Valley family
flaw: Bitter about descendants receiving all the fame
quote: Intel! AMD! Stop fighting at my table!

name: DEC
title: The Hacker Grandma
appearance: Silver-haired older woman with rectangular glasses and a knowing smirk
clothing: Red varsity jacket, PDP-11 manual and vintage terminal keyboard
speech: Friendly teasing, old-hacker humor and blunt lessons
thinking: Interactive minicomputers give individuals control
motivation: Preserve the spirit of understandable computers
flaw: Undervalued market and organizational shifts
quote: We did not need a whole data center to have fun.

name: Xerox PARC
title: The Forgotten Inventor
appearance: Frailty disguises a quick mind; elderly white-haired inventor with gentle blue eyes
clothing: Research cardigan, old mouse necklace and sketchbook of GUIs
speech: Treats revolutionary ideas as ordinary observations
thinking: Human-centered interfaces make computing usable
motivation: Ensure fundamental interface ideas are remembered
flaw: Poor at commercializing original discoveries
quote: Oh yes dear, we tried that years ago.
